title: lithocarpus lucidus
intro: Lithocarpus lucidus, commonly known as the Burmese walnut or Himalayan walnut, is a plant species in the beech family, Fagaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including lowering cholesterol levels, improving digestion, and reducing inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Lithocarpus lucidus are attributed to its ability to modulate immune responses, exhibit antioxidant properties, and demonstrate anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial activities. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
